title: AleoFortune
tagline: Aleo-based Web3 roulette app: Connect Puzzle wallet, deposit Aleo tokens, bet, spin, and withdraw winnings with ease, blending blockchain security with gaming excitement.
description:
Our project introduces a cutting-edge Web3 roulette application built on the innovative Aleo network, integrating the immersive world of online gaming with the security and transparency of blockchain technology. Users begin by connecting their Puzzle wallets, a seamless gateway to our platform. Once connected, they can deposit Roulette tokens, which are powered by the native Aleo tokens, providing a smooth transaction experience.

The core of our application is the roulette game itself, where users can place bets by spinning the digital wheel. This feature is not only engaging but also leverages the decentralized nature of blockchain, ensuring fairness and transparency in every game. After playing, users have the flexibility to withdraw their balance directly back to their Puzzle wallets, maintaining a secure and user-friendly environment.

Our app stands out by blending the excitement of roulette betting with the trustworthiness of blockchain technology, offering an innovative gaming experience that is both enjoyable and secure. This project aims to set a new standard for blockchain-based gaming, showcasing how decentralized technology can revolutionize traditional online gaming experiences.
how_its_made:
The core of our application is the smart contract, meticulously developed in Leo, Aleo's native programming language. Leo's capabilities were crucial in creating a secure, efficient, and transparent system for managing game logic, including bet placements and payouts. This choice ensured that our application adhered to the highest standards of blockchain security and privacy.

For the frontend, we utilized JavaScript to create a dynamic and user-friendly interface. This choice allowed us to build an engaging and intuitive experience for our users, making it easy for them to interact with the roulette game, place bets, and view their outcomes seamlessly.

Integration with the blockchain was made possible through the Puzzle wallet SDK. The Puzzle wallet's compatibility with the Aleo network made it an ideal choice for our application, enabling users to smoothly connect their wallets, deposit tokens, and withdraw winnings. This integration highlights our commitment to providing a secure and streamlined user experience, where transactions are not only simple but also align with the high privacy standards of the Aleo network.
